description: Smoother sprite animation: in-between frames from motion between your frames (4 frames to 8 or 12), pixel art stays crisp with no new colours, holds stay holds, loop seam included; sheet, JSON and a before/after GIF. Price: $0.05 USDC via x402, charged only on success. Part of Sprite tools: 2D sprite jobs for games: cut sprites out of their background (exact for one-color backgrounds, AI for busy ones), turn animation videos into aligned sprite sheets, make normal maps for 2D lights, build 47-tile autotile sets with Tiled, Godot and Unity rules, slice a sheet into frames, pack frames into an atlas with TexturePacker and Unity metadata, and turn upscaled or AI-generated pixel art into real pixel art on its true grid with a limited palette..

count.description: Frames used from the sheet when the last row is not full.

factor.description: 2: one new frame between each pair (4 frames become 8 for a loop); 3: two new frames.

fps.description: Frame rate of the original, for the preview.

frames.description: The animation frames in order, all the same size.

loop.description: Also make in-betweens from the last frame back to the first.

mode.description: pixel: crisp, no new colours; smooth: blended; auto picks pixel for hard alpha and a small palette.

sheet.description: Or one sprite sheet, cut into cols x rows equal cells (row by row).
